mapper.select: SELECT last_sequence FROM fulfillment_shadow_clock WHERE singleton_id=1
SELECT DISTINCT table_name, row_key FROM fulfillment_shadow_changes WHERE change_sequence > #{after} AND change_sequence <= #{through}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fulfillment_shadow_changes WHERE change_sequence > #{after} AND change_sequence <= #{through}
SELECT table_name,row_key,payload FROM fulfillment_shadow_rows ORDER BY table_name,row_key
SELECT table_name,row_key,payload FROM fulfillment_shadow_rows WHERE row_key=#{commandId} AND table_name IN ('fulfillment_shipment_jobs','fulfillment_merchant_jobs')
SELECT generation,source_sequence FROM fulfillment_shadow_watermark WHERE singleton_id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT DISTINCT order_id,merchant_id FROM order_items WHERE merchant_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT table_name,row_key,payload FROM fulfillment_shadow_quarantine ORDER BY table_name,row_key
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fulfillment_shadow_quarantine WHERE table_name=#{tableName} AND row_key=#{rowKey}
